units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:11">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>ובמושב לצים וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 1:1">Ps. I, 1</cite>) <he>שלא ישב בת׳</he> who never sat in bad company; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 613:1">Yalk. Ps. 613</cite>.—[

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a:6">Snh. 42ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>בתחבלות וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 24:6">Prov. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>במי אתה מוצא … חבילות חבילות של משנה</he> Ms. M. with whom wilt thou find the fight for the Law? With him in whose hand are bundles of laws of the Mishnah.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21:5">Lev. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>אם עשית חבילות של עבירות וכ׳</he> if thou hast done bundles of sins, undo them by bundles of good deeds.
<cite ref="Jonah 1:6">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>פתר קריא בקברניטא</he> referred that verse (Prov. l. c.) to a ship captain.]
